decisions.reason: GA4 is now the mandatory Google Analytics standard, so the plugin has clear, growing demand among shop clients and costs little to maintain.
Google shut down Universal Analytics data processing in 2023 and 2024, so the uncertainty about this option's value has resolved to zero and keeping it only ties up maintenance resources.
The retail system interface plugin is a cheap-to-hold option that fits the firm's integration expertise, and its prospects are still uncertain, so keeping it open is sensible.
SEO support for shop relaunches extends the firm's core relaunch business at low cost and is prominently presented on its own page, signalling commitment.
